AUDIT QUESTION: Review this diff (pipeline/select_passages.py, pipeline/pinned.py). ORCHESTRATOR RULING 142 (3) (14:32 ET Nov 17), verbatim in part: "POST-LIVE STREAMS: do not wait for YouTube ... get MeC8YEmUx_w's media by another route and cut locally: try the full download of the post_live DASH stream (not --download-sections) ... whichever yields a file whose audio matches the transcript timings (check the offset against the word timings before trusting it, a post_live file can be shifted). If one works, make it the standing fallback for any 'post_live' source, with the offset check as a HARD guard". Measured today: a post_live section download comes back with ~5 s of picture, 0.023 s of audio, a 0 s container; the whole audio (format 140) and video (137) download fine; the render's decoder sits -0.10 s from the word pass's records on that whole stream and -0.09 s on a normal (not_live) video: the decoders' own bias, not a shift.
FACTS (unchanged code): _download_window(video_id, start_s, end_s, run_dir, pad=15) downloads [round(start-15), end+15] with yt-dlp --download-sections into run_dir/sources/<id>.mp4 and returns (path, dl_start), dl_start being provenance (cut words are located by TEXT, never by offset arithmetic); a cached file over 100 KB is a cache hit. pinned.acquire calls _download_window then _whisper_transcribe (word times relative to the file), and raises PinError (a hold) on failure. REPO is the repository root; the word pass's records are data/editorial/transcripts/<id>/windows/<lo>-<hi>.whisper_words_punct.json with source-clock word times.
Cycle 2: try to BREAK it. Report ONLY a defect you can show with a CONCRETE file / stream / record state traced through the diff's code. Keep each "issue" under 80 words. If you cannot break it, answer PASS with no findings.
TARGETS:
T1. A shifted or wrong-video post_live source that the render would lock and cut.
T2. A normal source that now fails, or is replaced by a whole-stream cut.
T3. An exception, a cache reused across videos, or a file written outside the run's sources and the per-video cache.

+POST_LIVE_MAX_OFFSET_S = 0.35    # ruling 142 (3): the decoders' own bias is about 0.1 s (measured); a trimmed stream
+POST_LIVE_MIN_ALIGNED = 10       # shifts by seconds
+
+
+def post_live_offset(vid, tr, offset):
+    """RULING 142 (3): the HARD guard on a source cut from a post_live stream's whole download. The render's decode of the
+    window (word times + offset = the source clock), aligned word by word with the word pass's record of that video
+    that overlaps it most (data/editorial/transcripts/<id>/windows: the transcript's clock), must sit within
+    POST_LIVE_MAX_OFFSET_S (median) on at least POST_LIVE_MIN_ALIGNED words; else PinError (the lock holds). -> the
+    median offset in seconds."""
+    import glob
+    import statistics
+    from difflib import SequenceMatcher
+
+    def norm(w):
+        return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9']", "", str(w).lower())
+    mine = [(norm(w.get("word")), float(w["start"]) + offset) for w in tr.get("words") or [] if "start" in w]
+    if not mine:
+        raise PinError(f"{vid}: post_live source: the decode has no words to check its clock with (ruling 142 (3))")
+    lo, hi, best = mine[0][1], mine[-1][1], None
+    for p in glob.glob(os.path.join(REPO, "data", "editorial", "transcripts", vid, "windows", "*.json")):
+        try:
+            a, b = (float(x) for x in os.path.basename(p).split(".whisper")[0].split("-"))
+        except ValueError:
+            continue
+        ov = min(b, hi) - max(a, lo)
+        if ov > 0 and (best is None or ov > best[0]):
+            best = (ov, p)
+    if best is None:
+        raise PinError(f"{vid}: post_live source: no transcript word timings overlap the window, so its clock cannot be "
+                       f"checked (ruling 142 (3): HARD)")
+    with open(best[1]) as f:
+        rec = [(norm(w.get("word")), float(w["start"])) for w in json.load(f).get("words") or [] if "start" in w]
+    sm = SequenceMatcher(None, [m[0] for m in mine], [r[0] for r in rec], autojunk=False)
+    deltas = [mine[a + k][1] - rec[b + k][1] for op, a, a2, b, _ in sm.get_opcodes() if op == "equal"
+              for k in range(a2 - a)]
+    if len(deltas) < POST_LIVE_MIN_ALIGNED:
+        raise PinError(f"{vid}: post_live source: only {len(deltas)} words align with the transcript's timings (needs "
+                       f"{POST_LIVE_MIN_ALIGNED}): its clock cannot be checked (ruling 142 (3): HARD)")
+    med = statistics.median(deltas)
+    if abs(med) > POST_LIVE_MAX_OFFSET_S:
+        raise PinError(f"{vid}: post_live source shifted {med:+.2f} s against the transcript's word timings (ruling 142 "
+                       f"(3): within {POST_LIVE_MAX_OFFSET_S} s or the lock holds)")
+    return round(med, 3)
+
+

+POST_LIVE_DIR = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(PIPELINE_DIR), "data", "post_live_cache")    # ruling 142 (3): per video
+POST_LIVE_MIN_S = 0.5            # a file whose audio or container is shorter carries no media (a post_live DASH section)
+POST_LIVE_TIMEOUT_S = 1800       # one whole stream (MeC8YEmUx_w's 95 min: audio ~2 min, 1080p video ~8 min)
+
+
+def _has_media(path):
+    """False only when ffprobe READS the file and finds no media: its container or its audio shorter than
+    POST_LIVE_MIN_S, or no audio stream: what a post_live stream's DASH section downloads as (seconds of picture, no
+    audio, a 0 s container; ruling 142 (3)). A file ffprobe cannot read is left to the path that follows (True), as
+    before this check: the range and duration checks downstream hold on it."""
+    try:
+        r = subprocess.run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration:stream=codec_type,duration",
+                            "-of", "json", path], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
+        d = json.loads(r.stdout or "{}")
+    except Exception:
+        return True
+    if not isinstance(d, dict) or not isinstance(d.get("format"), dict) or not isinstance(d.get("streams"), list):
+        return True                                      # unreadable: not this check's to judge
+    try:
+        fmt = float(d["format"].get("duration") or 0)
+        aud = [float(s.get("duration") or 0) for s in d["streams"] if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("codec_type") == "audio"]
+    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+        return True
+    return fmt >= POST_LIVE_MIN_S and bool(aud) and max(aud) >= POST_LIVE_MIN_S
+
+
+def _post_live_window(video_id, dl_start, dl_end, out_path, cookies=None):
+    """RULING 142 (3) (orchestrator 2026-11-17 '14:32'): a post_live stream cannot be cut by --download-sections (DASH:
+    no audio comes back). Fetch the WHOLE audio and video once per video (POST_LIVE_DIR/<id>/, reused), then cut
+    [dl_start, dl_end] locally, re-encoded so the file starts at dl_start, and write <out_path>.post_live.json: the
+    route, so pinned.acquire checks this source's clock against the transcript's word timings (HARD). -> True when
+    out_path holds media."""
+    d = os.path.join(POST_LIVE_DIR, video_id)
+    os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
+    got = {}
+    for kind, fmt, name in (("audio", "bestaudio[acodec^=mp4a]/bestaudio", "audio.m4a"),
+                            ("video", "bestvideo[height<=1080][vcodec^=avc1]/bestvideo[height<=1080]", "video.mp4")):
+        p = os.path.join(d, name)
+        if not (os.path.exists(p) and os.path.getsize(p) > 100_000):
+            cmd = ["yt-dlp", "-f", fmt, "-o", p, "--no-part", "--no-warnings", "--quiet",
+                   f"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={video_id}"] + (["--cookies", cookies] if cookies else [])
+            try:
+                subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=POST_LIVE_TIMEOUT_S)
+            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+                print(f"    WARN: post_live whole-stream download timeout for {video_id} ({kind})")
+                return False
+        if not (os.path.exists(p) and os.path.getsize(p) > 100_000):
+            return False
+        got[kind] = p
+    cmd = ["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-y", "-ss", f"{dl_start:.3f}", "-i", got["video"], "-ss", f"{dl_start:.3f}",
+           "-i", got["audio"], "-t", f"{dl_end - dl_start:.3f}", "-map", "0:v:0", "-map", "1:a:0",
+           "-c:v", "libx264", "-crf", "17", "-preset", "veryfast", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
+           "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "192k", "-ar", "48000", "-ac", "2", "-movflags", "+faststart", out_path]
+    try:
+        subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=900, check=True)
+    except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
+        return False
+    if not _has_media(out_path):
+        return False
+    with open(out_path + ".post_live.json", "w") as f:
+        json.dump({"route": "post_live_whole_stream", "video_id": video_id, "window": [dl_start, dl_end],
+                   "audio": got["audio"], "video": got["video"]}, f)
+    return True
+
+

-        return out_path, dl_start

+        os.remove(out_path)                          # ruling 142 (3): a post_live stream's DASH section has no media
